rule: No optional third-party API fees, no paid SaaS dependencies, no recurring integration subscriptions, and no feature that can generate an external bill merely because people use it.

coreInfrastructure: Firebase/GCP infrastructure already required to operate Tiny Titans, subject to normal project quotas and billing controls
transactionCosts: Stripe/payment processing fees only when Tiny Titans actually receives money

allowedOptionalProviders.name: iNaturalist Wild Ecology
allowedOptionalProviders.basis: free public API with Tiny Titans cache and pacing

allowedOptionalProviders.name: Open-Meteo geocoding/context
allowedOptionalProviders.basis: free public API used with bounded/cached access where applicable

explicitlyDisallowedByDefault: Any SaaS connector whose normal user activity can create a third-party usage bill
paidApiDecisionRule: First ask whether Tiny Titans can build the useful outcome itself for effectively £0. If yes, build it. If not, keep it disabled until Tiny Titans revenue justifies the cost and the policy is deliberately changed.
